title: Adaptive Workload Batôn Profiling and Safe Batch-Apply Pipeline
creator: Sana Patel
description: Build an end-to-end recommendation engine ("Baton") that continuously profiles per-route and per-customer workload characteristics to produce batching and prefix/KV caching recommendations, and safely applies them via a canary/circuit-breaker rollout with automatic rollback. Focus is on minimizing cost per token without violating latency SLOs or increasing error rates. The system combines lightweight heuristics with a fast model (statistical or ML-lite) and a safety control-plane that performs shadow experiments and incremental rollouts. This ticket covers design, infra, heuristic library, rollout controller, observability and a first production pilot for select non-critical routes.
acceptance_criteria: Baton profiles live traffic and stores time-series summaries (per route, per customer, by seq_len buckets) to ClickHouse/TSDB with <10s ingestion latency
Recommendation engine outputs batch-size and kv-prefix caching suggestions with confidence score and rationale for each route
Safe-apply controller supports shadow-apply, gradual canary (0%->100% in N steps), and automated rollback based on metric gates
Rollout gates detect regressions on p95 latency, error rate, and token cost; any gate breach triggers immediate rollback and postmortem recording
Pilot run on two internal staging routes showing >=12% cost reduction without >2% p95 latency regression
Detailed runbook and Dashboard (Console tile) for rollout status, change diff and rollback reasons
Unit/integration tests for heuristic modules and e2e smoke test for safe-apply workflow
comments: 2026-02-16 - Sana P.: Kickoff with PM and Runtime leads. Agreed scope: profiling -> recommender -> safe-apply. Priority to non-customer-facing routes first. Action: Miguel to prototype profiler sketch using sampled traces.

2026-02-22 - Miguel O.: PoC: profiler agent running as sidecar emits summary metrics: seq_len_histogram, inter-arrival quantiles, burstiness index, kv-hit-estimates. Early findings: one staging route shows heavy tail seq_len > 1024 causing batching inefficiencies.

2026-02-28 - Design review (Aisha K.): UX requirement: Console must show per-change expected cost delta and safety score. Need a diff view comparing current vs proposed batch config and example request flows.

2026-03-03 - Eng sync: Decided heuristic stack: (1) windowed burst-decay detector, (2) quantile-based safe batch caps, (3) kv-prefix affinity scorer; fallback to conservative config when confidence < 0.6. Implemented confidence calculus using sample counts + variance.

2026-03-06 - Miguel O.: Implemented shadow-apply runner. Works by duplicating requests to candidate config in shadow and recording token/time deltas. Disk-backed buffer and replay capability added for short outages.

2026-03-09 - Ops (Leila R.): Instrumented alerts for rollout gates: p95_latency_increase > 10% OR error_rate_absolute > 0.5% OR token_cost_increase > 8% triggers rollback. Need to tune thresholds during pilot.
2026-03-10 - Sana P.: Updated acceptance criteria after pilot target review. Next: schedule pilot on two staging routes (search-preview and summarizer-dev) and prepare dashboards.
